Subscriptions and flex packages Subscriptions and flex packages

Join us throughout the season – whether in symphony concerts of the Berliner Philharmoniker or series of the most diverse genres. With a subscription, first and foremost, you secure your tickets, with a saving of up to 30% on the single ticket price. Or enjoy complete freedom and put together your own personal concert program with our flex packages.

Subscriptions with the Berliner Philharmoniker

The symphonic subscription series of the Berliner Philharmoniker reflect the complete range of orchestral music.

Find out more

Chamber music, jazz, world & co.

Music from a wide variety of perspectives, from baroque music to jazz, from vocal music to piano recitals

Series for families

Our Education programme presents: Family and Interactive concerts as packages

Flex packages

With our Flex packages, you can put together your own programme of three, five or nine concerts – and save up to 15 %!
